description: This file provides implementation of distributed lock operations (acquire, release, renew, status) in a Storage package, supporting both BoltDB and PostgreSQL backends, with unique lock handling logic and integration with external types.

methods.name: AcquireLock
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a distributed lock, using either PostgreSQL or BoltDB depending on storage mode.

methods.name: ReleaseLock
methods.description: Releases a previously acquired distributed lock.

methods.name: RenewLock
methods.description: Extends the TTL of an existing distributed lock.

methods.name: GetLockStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status and details of a distributed lock by key.

methods.name: acquireLockPostgres
methods.description: Implements lock acquisition logic specific to PostgreSQL backend.

methods.name: releaseLockPostgres
methods.description: Implements lock release logic for PostgreSQL.

methods.name: renewLockPostgres
methods.description: Renews a lock in PostgreSQL, extending its expiry.

methods.name: getLockStatusPostgres
methods.description: Fetches lock status from PostgreSQL database.
